1980_crown_victoria: Nobody saw Teodor Victoria arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in V-F19, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Teodor Victoria pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Wind kept turning the pages of Teodor Victoria's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.
Teodor Victoria found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.

The Hegemony raiders were in and out in two minutes. At V-F19 they left Teodor Victoria behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Florian Grishagoblin of the Hegemony (@grishagoblin).
Gideon Victoria arrived carrying the family name of Teodor Victoria. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
alibrahimovic1_: Nobody saw Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in N-F6, and a quiet rifleman under it.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Nobody else in N-F6 wanted the stripes. Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi said yes. Lance Corporal.

Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. After what happened at Lantern Hill, Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi asked to serve as a sniper. Nobody argued.

Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home reached Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi before dusk. Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi read it twice and slept a little easier.
Emil "Button" Alibrahimovi lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
anthony_salerno17: The new rifleman gave his name as Isidor "Ghost" Salerno. The corporal looked at his boots, then at the mud, and laughed for the first time in a week. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Isidor "Ghost" Salerno put a folded ration label under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal.

Fog so thick that Isidor "Ghost" Salerno could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno asked to leave the riflemans and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Isidor "Ghost" Salerno went out with the wiring party at U-F6. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit. A letter from home found Isidor "Ghost" Salerno before the night shift. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno folded it small and kept it close.

At U-F6 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno won the bet. Arno "Saint" Metal was gravely wounded. A letter from home found Isidor "Ghost" Salerno before the night shift. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno folded it small and kept it close.

Isidor "Ghost" Salerno and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Isidor "Ghost" Salerno fired. Karel "Crow" Metal was gravely wounded. A letter for Isidor "Ghost" Salerno said the whole street was asking about the front. Isidor "Ghost" Salerno did not know where to begin the answer.
bob.bobkin.921: "You're late," said the corporal when Arno "Mud" Bobkin arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Arno "Mud" Bobkin helped stack spare sandbags at R-R8. Nobody asked when they would be needed. A letter from home reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin before dusk. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read it twice and slept a little easier.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Arno "Mud" Bobkin aimed just below it. Bram "Smokes" Internetmang was grazed. A letter from home reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin before dusk. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read it twice and slept a little easier. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Arno "Mud" Bobkin is number 816. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-R8 with the rations. Arno "Mud" Bobkin ate while listening to the revised orders.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Arno "Mud" Bobkin fired, and Viktor Kvasnicka was grazed. A letter from home reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin before dusk. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read it twice and slept a little easier. Arno "Mud" Bobkin asked to leave the machine gunners and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.
The village shop had three kinds of soap. Arno "Mud" Bobkin stood at the counter far longer than the purchase required.

A supply man offered Arno "Mud" Bobkin a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. A letter from home reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin before dusk. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno "Mud" Bobkin coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays an operatic duet nobody can translate, but something knocks once every revolution. A letter from home reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin before dusk. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read it twice and slept a little easier.

Arno "Mud" Bobkin moved his hide three times today. Snipers who stay in one place do not stay anywhere for long. A short letter reached Arno "Mud" Bobkin: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Arno "Mud" Bobkin read the part about the dog twice.
bradb0wman: Dorian Wman, a dance-hall violinist from Halden, was sent forward on Day 3 to fill a gap in R-F5. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it. The Concord secured Verdel Ridge. Dorian Wman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Dorian Wman had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Dorian Wman. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

Dorian Wman spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F5 is closed now. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Dorian Wman read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A recruit asked Dorian Wman how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label. A letter from home found Dorian Wman before the night shift. Dorian Wman folded it small and kept it close.

The men argued about whether fish sleep. Dorian Wman said yes, and was told to explain how anyone could know. A letter from home found Dorian Wman before the night shift. Dorian Wman folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian Wman was hit in the forearm at R-F5. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Matthias "Rabbit" Forn of the Hegemony (@88forn). A letter from home found Dorian Wman before the night shift. Dorian Wman folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian Wman's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F5 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home found Dorian Wman before the night shift. Dorian Wman folded it small and kept it close.

Dorian Wman was hit through the stomach at R-F5. The bearers ran with the stretcher and did not stop to rest. Shot by Nils "Bones" Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21). Dorian Wman was killed outright at R-F5, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Nils "Bones" Martinvajda of the Hegemony (@martinvajda.21).
Florian Wman arrived carrying the family name of Dorian Wman. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.

A bullet went through Florian Wman's sleeve at R-F5 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Albin Icespiceynod of the Hegemony (@icespiceynoddlrs). A letter from home found Florian Wman before the night shift. Florian Wman folded it small and kept it close. The clerk counted the names twice. Florian Wman is number 193 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is lost. Florian Wman heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
The medic looked at Florian Wman's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F5. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Florian Wman shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Clement Kabu, was grazed.
Florian Wman bought a small phrasebook from a passing soldier. The first useful sentence appears after six pages about hiring a carriage.
Florian Wman wrote a letter for Roland Bryce's mother, because Roland could not find the words. Roland signed it.
Nobody heard the Hegemony raiders cut the wire. Florian Wman only heard boots on the duckboards at R-F5, then nothing but pain. Raider: Ivo "Bones" Rylan of the Hegemony (@rylan_45h).
caydan__: Dietrich Caydan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-F12 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Dietrich Caydan was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.

Dietrich Caydan was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony. On Day 3, Verdel Ridge passed to the Concord. Dietrich Caydan wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Dietrich Caydan closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.

Dietrich Caydan caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either. A letter from home reached Dietrich Caydan before dusk. Dietrich Caydan read it twice and slept a little easier.

Dietrich Caydan pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under Lantern Hill and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Caydan watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Dietrich Caydan measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
Dietrich Caydan fixed the strap on Ulrich Axelat's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Dietrich Caydan was hit in the hip at S-F12. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Edmund Matteozrybak of the Hegemony (@matteozrybak).
No bed, no surgeon, just a medic with a kit and a lot of patience. Dietrich Caydan recovered anyway and is back at S-F12.
News of the loss of Blackwater Canal reached S-F12 with the rations. Dietrich Caydan ate while listening to the revised orders.

Dietrich Caydan was hit in the forearm at S-F12. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Jonas Bon of the Hegemony (@tiberius.bon). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Caydan wrote to the people he used to know that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Dietrich Caydan was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-F12. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Benedikt "Button" Niarchos of the Hegemony (@niarchos_n). The bearers reached Dietrich Caydan at S-F12 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Benedikt "Button" Niarchos of the Hegemony (@niarchos_n).
Silas Caydan arrived carrying the family name of Dietrich Caydan. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Silas Caydan wrote a letter for Ulrich Axelat's mother, because Ulrich could not find the words. Ulrich signed it.
Silas Caydan wrote a song about Saint-Ash crossroads. Roland Zle wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Silas Caydan and Roland Zle made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F12 and grazed Silas Caydan's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Quentin "Parson" Broeringluke of the Hegemony (@broeringluke).
cooper_chappell22: Ivo "Tin" Chappell introduced himself as a tram conductor from Dunmarrow. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Ivo "Tin" Chappell landed next to Benedikt Kfg in the Hegemony trench. Only Ivo "Tin" Chappell climbed back out. (@felix.kfg) Ivo "Tin" Chappell threw a bomb into a Hegemony dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Ivo Hohne was down and screaming for a medic. (@shawn_hohne) Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Ivo "Tin" Chappell wrote down the news without trying to explain it. A letter from home reached Ivo "Tin" Chappell before dusk. Ivo "Tin" Chappell read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders assigned Ivo "Tin" Chappell to work as a signaller. The first lesson began with what not to touch.

The colonel asked who held the line at the Drowned Farm last night. Every finger pointed at Ivo "Tin" Chappell. Lance Corporal. A letter from home reached Ivo "Tin" Chappell before dusk. Ivo "Tin" Chappell read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Ivo "Tin" Chappell is number 677 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-C13. Ivo "Tin" Chappell has learned to walk bent double.
The telephone wire to R-C13 was cut by shelling four times. Ivo "Tin" Chappell crawled out and spliced it four times.
Ivo "Tin" Chappell lost a boot in the trench. Norbert "Bones" Primum found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
Ivo "Tin" Chappell went out with the wiring party at R-C13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
The last of the jam was shared by passing the tin around. Ivo "Tin" Chappell approved the method.

The Hegemony sentry, Zeno Smiridisnick, shouted once. Ivo "Tin" Chappell silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@smiridisnick) The squad counted heads when the raiders came back. Ivo "Tin" Chappell was missing. At dawn they saw Ivo "Tin" Chappell lying by the wire. Killed in the night raid by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Bram Chappell took the same post at R-C13 where Ivo "Tin" Chappell stood. He found his older brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
cringlethepringle_21: On the way to R-R4, Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-R4. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Chauhan of the Hegemony (@prithvirajs.chauhan). From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-R4 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr is number 920. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R4. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr has learned to walk bent double.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.

Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at R-R4. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).
The medic cut the last bandage off Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R4 the same hour.
A single shot from across the wire hit Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr in the thigh at R-R4. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Emil Painter of the Hegemony (@neophyte_painter).
The bearers moved Silas "Smokes" Cringlethepr's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
dill_ethan: Yann Ethan signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at V-F11 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Konrad Alexandernym and Yann Ethan tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Yann Ethan tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at V-F11 is up. At V-F11 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Yann Ethan won the bet. Karel "Mud" Ajango was grazed. A letter from home found Yann Ethan before the night shift. Yann Ethan folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Ethan had just lit a cigarette at V-F11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Yann Operatortex of the Concord (@operatortex145). A letter from home found Yann Ethan before the night shift. Yann Ethan folded it small and kept it close.

Yann Ethan walked back up the communication trench to V-F11, slower than before, but on his own feet. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Ethan. Yann Ethan read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
dilloncoll2015: In Ashford Vale, Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was a railway porter. In R-F17, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a railway porter again.

Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll received the rank of Lance Corporal and a stack of unfinished paperwork. The congratulations lasted less time than the paperwork. Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll tried to describe the smell of Ashford Vale and got as far as the bakery. Then the ration cart arrived.

A second spoon disappeared. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll fired at a movement across the wire at R-F17. The man went down: Lucien "Button" Rachelejosia, grazed.

Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll was hit through the chest at R-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord (@sus.danny2.0). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll fell at R-F17 and never moved again. Shot by Quentin "Shadow" Danny of the Concord (@sus.danny2.0).
Dietrich Dilloncoll came to the front because his older brother Nils "Brick" Dilloncoll never came home. He carries a key to a house that is no longer there.

Dietrich Dilloncoll was hit in the forearm at R-F17. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Wendel "Smokes" Mrsh of the Concord (@le.mrsh_).
The medic looked at Dietrich Dilloncoll's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-F17. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F17 in the middle of the night. Dietrich Dilloncoll met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Walter "Ghost" Wizzerd of the Concord (@flying_wizzerd).
Tobias Dilloncoll asked about Dietrich Dilloncoll on arriving at R-F17. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.

A patient at the aid post asked Tobias Dilloncoll for a pencil. By evening, the wall beside the stretcher bore a drawing of a kitchen. Tobias Dilloncoll got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 163. The men who came later will ask about it. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at R-F17 changed before the cheering ended. Tobias Dilloncoll shouldered another load.
A bullet went through Tobias Dilloncoll's sleeve at R-F17 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Hugo Adamjedlicka of the Concord (@adamjedlicka28).
The medics cleaned Tobias Dilloncoll's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-F17.

Tobias Dilloncoll had just lit a cigarette at R-F17 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord (@colemarkpearson).

Tobias Dilloncoll was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F17, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord (@colemarkpearson). Tobias Dilloncoll was hit at R-F17 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Benedikt "Saint" Colemarkpear of the Concord (@colemarkpearson).
Rafael Dilloncoll joined R-F17 under the shadow of Tobias Dilloncoll's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F17 they left Rafael Dilloncoll behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Anselm Rakan of the Concord (@rakan_1027).
Albin Dilloncoll put a key to a house that is no longer there beside the bunk. Someone who had known Rafael Dilloncoll helped clear the shelf without saying why.
dumbasian619: Bram "Parson" Dumbasian left a wife and a daughter he has never met behind in Saint-Lune and came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Bram "Parson" Dumbasian watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Bram "Parson" Dumbasian tried to remember the price of a loaf in Saint-Lune. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into Q-F16. Bram "Parson" Dumbasian has learned to walk bent double.
Bram "Parson" Dumbasian reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F16 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Felix Luccisan of the Hegemony (@luccisan191).
Bram "Parson" Dumbasian no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Bram "Parson" Dumbasian wrote a song about Saint-Ash crossroads. Gideon Nkmcnamee wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
Dawn watch. Bram "Parson" Dumbasian put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Walter Thefreakones, badly wounded.
A bullet hit the sandbag beside Bram "Parson" Dumbasian. He ducked, and noticed his hands were shaking. He kept working anyway.
hunnnter_hume: In Wyvern Cross, Henrik "Shadow" Hume was a coal miner. In S-R11, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a coal miner again.

Dawn watch. Henrik "Shadow" Hume put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bastian "Saint" Pablo, badly wounded. Blackwater Canal has been won. Henrik "Shadow" Hume listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Henrik "Shadow" Hume has fired hundreds of rounds into the dark. Today one of them found someone: Tobias Avtomat, grazed. Henrik "Shadow" Hume raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Silas "Brick" Little of the Concord (@evan.little.14). News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Henrik "Shadow" Hume during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Henrik "Shadow" Hume's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Henrik "Shadow" Hume won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-R11. The lance corporal wants a rematch.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. The men at S-R11 heard Henrik "Shadow" Hume call out once and then go quiet. They found him hit in the back, still holding the rifle. Henrik "Shadow" Hume finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Henrik "Shadow" Hume's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
Henrik "Shadow" Hume never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
Rematch. Henrik "Shadow" Hume lost everything he won, plus a tin of tobacco. The whole dugout watched.
inked.yeti: Gideon "Spark" Yeti left his mother, who writes every Sunday behind in Esterhaus and came up the line with a child's drawing of a horse. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Gideon "Spark" Yeti looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Gideon "Spark" Yeti discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Gideon "Spark" Yeti wrote to his mother, who writes every Sunday that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F19 and grazed Gideon "Spark" Yeti's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony (@le_vigneaux).

Gideon "Spark" Yeti was hit in the hip at Q-F19. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Bastian Vigneaux of the Hegemony (@le_vigneaux). Mail came up the line with a letter for Gideon "Spark" Yeti. Gideon "Spark" Yeti read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Gideon "Spark" Yeti died on a stretcher outside the aid post, still waiting for a bed. The medics had nothing left to give him.
Jonas "Mole" Yeti came to the front because his brother Gideon "Spark" Yeti never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
A round came through the loophole Jonas "Mole" Yeti was watching at Q-F19 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Viktor Adamsapple of the Hegemony (@adamsapple128).
Jonas "Mole" Yeti spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice.
joncheng13: Casimir Joncheng found a place in U-F9 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak. Casimir Joncheng reported for duty as a signaller. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Casimir Joncheng and Gideon Garbet carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. A letter from home found Casimir Joncheng before the night shift. Casimir Joncheng folded it small and kept it close. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Casimir Joncheng watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

A round came through the loophole Casimir Joncheng was watching at U-F9 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc of the Hegemony (@donathanpanchothethird). Casimir Joncheng was killed outright at U-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon "Brick" Donathanpanc of the Hegemony (@donathanpanchothethird).
Yann Joncheng asked about Casimir Joncheng on arriving at U-F9. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
Yann Joncheng counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
A note came over the wire at Lantern Hill, wrapped around a stone: 'Stop singing, Concord. Signed, Matthias Mnp.' Yann Joncheng sang louder.
Yann Joncheng and Konrad Tripletonyt share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Yann Joncheng waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.
jozifanderson: Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso took the place of a man nobody would talk about. The dugout still had his blanket. He kept it folded.
First Wave. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a bullet that missed him.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at the Chalk Pits, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso was promoted to Lance Corporal.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso pulled Rafael "Lucky" Donaldgregor out of a flooded shell hole at the Drowned Farm. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso's bunk. He has named it Little Sergeant.

Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Quentin Adams crossed it, Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso fired. Quentin Adams was grazed. A shell burst over R-F11 and threw Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso into the side of the trench. Cuts, bruises, ringing ears. He stayed at his post. News that the Hegemony had taken Hill 304 reached Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A medic checked Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso's dressing at R-F11 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso in the open at R-F11. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_). The bearers reached Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso at R-F11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).

Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso joined R-F11 under the shadow of Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one. Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso received the First Wave ribbon. He checked the stitching twice before putting the tunic back on.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso was faster. Clement "Saint" Yokley was grazed.
Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Clement "Saint" Yokley was badly wounded.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Konrad Sebs and Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso argued all night about whose hometown has the better beer. They agreed to finish the argument after the war. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Wendel Goober was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Quentin Joelauramorr, badly wounded.
A round went through the rim of Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Wendel Schwols of the Concord (@erwin_schwols).
Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso rejoined the squad at R-F11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

The Concord raiders came over at R-F11 in the middle of the night. Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Ulrich Alessiosanto of the Concord (@alessiosantori).
Another member of the House of Jozifanderso reached the line: Marek Jozifanderso. He asked where Oskar "Whistle" Jozifanderso had slept, then chose a different corner.
justafungi77: On Day 9, Jonas Justafungi arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The water jacket hissed as Jonas Justafungi fired across no man's land. When the gun went quiet, Casimir Chickenman was grazed. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Jonas Justafungi stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Jonas Justafungi polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Justafungi watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Jonas Justafungi cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
Jonas Justafungi fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Albin "Saint" Aruuki was grazed.
Jonas Justafungi fired at the enemy dawn watch from Q-F10. Konrad "Mud" Pawington was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Jonas Justafungi fired, and Tobias "Crow" Nickloser was badly wounded.
Jonas Justafungi saved the last of the sugar for Gustav "Tin" Ratpick's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Tin's birthday. It was a good day anyway.
kq.erenn: Otto "Crow" Erenn left a wife and a daughter he has never met behind in Brennmoor and came up the line with a pocket Bible with a hole in it. The men noticed at once that he whistles the same four notes over and over.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Otto "Crow" Erenn could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

A report called the trench satisfactory. Otto "Crow" Erenn invited the author to spend a night in it before signing. Otto "Crow" Erenn got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 935. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Otto "Crow" Erenn helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Otto "Crow" Erenn raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-C12. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Arno "Hollow" Grizzlychick of the Concord (@grizzlychicken1).

Otto "Crow" Erenn took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-C12, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Florian Monkey of the Concord (@autistic_monkey3).

The bearers moved Otto "Crow" Erenn's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. Mail came up the line with a letter for Otto "Crow" Erenn. Otto "Crow" Erenn read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A medic stopped by Otto "Crow" Erenn's stretcher every few hours for a week. Today the medic found it empty. Otto "Crow" Erenn had gone back to S-C12.
Otto "Crow" Erenn had orders to attack at dawn. He wrote back asking for artillery first. The orders were cancelled. Nobody knows which of his words did it.
liam_jowett05: By the time Yann "Crow" Jowett reached W-F12, the war was 14 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Yann "Crow" Jowett found an old map of the Brickworks from before the war. There was a school on it, and an orchard. He looked for them. He did not find them. A letter from home reached Yann "Crow" Jowett before dusk. Yann "Crow" Jowett read it twice and slept a little easier.

Yann "Crow" Jowett found water collecting beneath the gun's cover. He sketched a small shelter and took the drawing to the stores. The letter for Yann "Crow" Jowett was written in pencil, with a lot of crossing out. Yann "Crow" Jowett liked the crossed-out parts best.
milkalberry: The new sniper is Lucien Milkalberry, once a schoolteacher from Greyhallow. The corporal asked if a schoolteacher was any use in a trench. Lucien Milkalberry said he would find out. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Lucien Milkalberry folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Lucien Milkalberry pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Lucien Milkalberry was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
A newspaper reached Lucien Milkalberry with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Lucien Milkalberry shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Nils "Rabbit" Prestonfeagi, was gravely wounded.

Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Lucien Milkalberry only heard boots on the duckboards at P-F3, then nothing but pain. Raider: Marek "Brick" Pyroholio of the Concord (@the_great_pyroholio).
mr_bonie3: The quartermaster asked Gustav Bonie to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Gustav Bonie helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home found Gustav Bonie before the night shift. Gustav Bonie folded it small and kept it close.

Gustav Bonie laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. A letter from home found Gustav Bonie before the night shift. Gustav Bonie folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Gustav Bonie folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Gustav Bonie fired at the enemy dawn watch from T-F11. Dietrich Realpayton was badly wounded, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A round went through the rim of Gustav Bonie's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Emil "Doc" Weir of the Concord (@walkem.down.weir).

The medic looked at Gustav Bonie's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F11. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows. A letter from home found Gustav Bonie before the night shift. Gustav Bonie folded it small and kept it close.
Asked what he will do after the war, Gustav Bonie said: 'Be a baker in Oakmere. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

Fresh from training, Gustav Bonie still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Bastian Tartochuk, grazed. A letter from home found Gustav Bonie before the night shift. Gustav Bonie folded it small and kept it close.
Gustav Bonie had Roland "Button" Lahetta of the Concord in the sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Roland "Button" Lahetta was lighting a pipe. Gustav Bonie let the match burn all the way down.
msn06ss: Walter "Parson" Msn arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pocket Bible with a hole in it and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Walter "Parson" Msn could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Walter "Parson" Msn and Bastian "Mud" Hi split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. The clerk counted the names twice. Walter "Parson" Msn is number 889 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Walter "Parson" Msn did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Walter "Parson" Msn carried in Pip, who lied about his age to enlist. Pip kept asking whether his mother would be told. A letter from home reached Walter "Parson" Msn before dusk. Walter "Parson" Msn read it twice and slept a little easier. Orders came through: Walter "Parson" Msn is a sapper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pocket Bible with a hole in it.
Walter "Parson" Msn found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
Walter "Parson" Msn went out with the wiring party at R-C11. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
Walter "Parson" Msn wrote a letter for Edmund "Shadow" Idkdunnoman's mother, because Shadow could not find the words. Shadow signed it.
A shell landed close to R-C11. When the dust settled Walter "Parson" Msn was still there, holding a pocket Bible with a hole in it, laughing without sound.
od_0_do_oficera: Ivo Oficera arrived on Day 11 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Ivo Oficera helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Ivo Oficera counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Leopold Evans was grazed. A round went through the rim of Ivo Oficera's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Otto "Spark" Kraljmk of the Concord (@kraljmk87). A letter from home found Ivo Oficera before the night shift. Ivo Oficera folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Oficera no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. A letter from home found Ivo Oficera before the night shift. Ivo Oficera folded it small and kept it close. The machine gunners took Ivo Oficera in on a busy morning in U-F19. By noon he had learned the first rule of the job, and by evening the second.

Ivo Oficera found an old shopping list inside a coat pocket. Soap, lamp oil, apples. He folded it along the original creases. A letter from home found Ivo Oficera before the night shift. Ivo Oficera folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Oficera remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped. A letter from home found Ivo Oficera before the night shift. Ivo Oficera folded it small and kept it close.

Ivo Oficera was on the dawn watch at U-F19 when the Concord raiders came. A club, a shout, and Ivo Oficera was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Clement Realjospence of the Concord (@realjospence). A letter came for Ivo Oficera with a ribbon tied around it. Ivo Oficera kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
pasta.v69: Karel "Mud" Pasta came up with a draft of replacements on Day 9. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-C12 changed before the cheering ended. Karel "Mud" Pasta shouldered another load.

A supply man offered Karel "Mud" Pasta a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records. The clerk counted the names twice. Karel "Mud" Pasta is number 961 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Karel "Mud" Pasta walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Karel "Mud" Pasta got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.
Karel "Mud" Pasta coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a march played slightly too slowly, but something knocks once every revolution.
Karel "Mud" Pasta was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.

Karel "Mud" Pasta counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Florian Monkey was badly wounded. A round went through Karel "Mud" Pasta's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz).
Karel "Mud" Pasta no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
pickapic0325: By the time Zeno Pickapic reached T-F16, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A clear shot from T-F16. Zeno Pickapic gravely wounded Marek "Lucky" Kid and slid back down below the parapet. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Zeno Pickapic helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
A man asked Zeno Pickapic to describe Dunmarrow without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
Zeno Pickapic measured the remaining pencil against the remaining paper. For once, the supplies seemed likely to run out together.
Wind kept turning the pages of Zeno Pickapic's letter. He held them down with a biscuit and finished with crumbs in the ink.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Zeno Pickapic shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Severin "Mud" Kid, was grazed.
Zeno Pickapic had just lit a cigarette at T-F16 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Florian Jug of the Concord (@wicker_jug).
rajasthan_ka_aquaman: Day 9: Rafael Aquaman reached R-R2 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.

A bullet clipped Rafael Aquaman's helmet at R-R2 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Dietrich Mindblot of the Concord (@mindblot55). Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Rafael Aquaman shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

The medic cut the last bandage off Rafael Aquaman's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to R-R2 the same hour. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Rafael Aquaman helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Rafael Aquaman drew the counter-mine plans by candlelight. Below the Sunken Road the earth is now a maze, and he knows every turn.
Fog hid the far end of R-R2. Rafael Aquaman kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout.
Rafael Aquaman got a photo of the family house. He spent longer looking at the strange curtains than at the faces.

Rafael Aquaman was found at the bottom of the trench at R-R2, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Lucien Bowles of the Concord (@sam_bowles_). Rafael Aquaman was killed outright at R-R2, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Lucien Bowles of the Concord (@sam_bowles_).
Walter Aquaman took the same post at R-R2 where Rafael Aquaman stood. He found his brother's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.
Walter Aquaman carried Konrad Embersky's rifle all the way up to the Bone Quarry after Konrad twisted an ankle. Neither has said thank you. Neither needs to.
raphixdx: Cyril Raphixdx came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Second Lieutenant and pointed at the mud.

A round went through Cyril Raphixdx's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Yann Rattamus of the Concord (@rattamus2_1). Victory at Blackwater Canal. Cyril Raphixdx let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The wound on Cyril Raphixdx's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Cyril Raphixdx is number 988. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril Raphixdx folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A bullet hit Cyril Raphixdx in the neck at S-C16. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz). Cyril Raphixdx stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-C16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Dorian Noahz of the Concord (@702.noahz).
Casimir Raphixdx joined S-C16 under the shadow of Cyril Raphixdx's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.

Casimir Raphixdx was carrying water up to S-C16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Casimir Raphixdx did not. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni). Casimir Raphixdx was killed at S-C16 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Gustav Burgosgeovan of the Concord (@burgosgeovanni).
Lucien "Ash" Raphixdx arrived carrying the family name of Casimir Raphixdx. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Lucien "Ash" Raphixdx of the Hegemony spotted Silas Wumpus of the Concord repairing a parapet at the Sunken Road. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.

Lucien "Ash" Raphixdx took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-C16, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Felix "Button" White of the Concord (@harry_white_y).
Lucien "Ash" Raphixdx asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.
The House of Raphixdx sent Nils Raphixdx after Lucien "Ash" Raphixdx. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
recon.raven14: The new machine gunner is Konrad "Spark" Raven, once a glassblower from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a glassblower was any use in a trench. Konrad "Spark" Raven said he would find out. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Konrad "Spark" Raven watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Konrad "Spark" Raven borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. A letter from home found Konrad "Spark" Raven before the night shift. Konrad "Spark" Raven folded it small and kept it close.
Konrad "Spark" Raven found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.
The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Konrad "Spark" Raven was faster. Ivo Razziel was badly wounded.
Konrad "Spark" Raven dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.

The Hegemony raiders came over at N-F10 in the middle of the night. Konrad "Spark" Raven met them first and did not survive the fight. Killed in the night raid by Felix Dougc of the Hegemony (@dougc117).
Another member of the House of Raven reached the line: Zeno "Hollow" Raven. He asked where Konrad "Spark" Raven had slept, then chose a different corner.
thebaileeblanks: Florian "Button" Thebaileebla left an old neighbor who promised to keep his garden alive behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he laughs at exactly the wrong moments. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla taught Jakub Lilsaint to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
Asked what he will do after the war, Florian "Button" Thebaileebla said: 'Be a railway porter in Marrow Fen. And never complain about anything, ever again.'

A bullet found Florian "Button" Thebaileebla at S-F17, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Albin Warhamster of the Concord (@warhamster4). The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
There was no bed for Florian "Button" Thebaileebla. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.
There was never a bed for Florian "Button" Thebaileebla, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F17 on his own feet.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla and Jakub Faulerhund carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F17 and grazed Florian "Button" Thebaileebla's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).

Back on the fire step at S-F17. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla walked the captured trenches of Blackwater Canal and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Florian "Button" Thebaileebla was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at S-F17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec of the Concord (@crabbithesecond). Florian "Button" Thebaileebla got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 187. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Florian "Button" Thebaileebla fixed the strap on Zeno Ramsey's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
A bullet clipped Florian "Button" Thebaileebla's helmet at S-F17 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Karel Leothebeo of the Concord (@leothebeo8).

A bullet went through Florian "Button" Thebaileebla's upper arm at S-F17 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Clement Unseen of the Concord (@unseen_28_). A single shot at S-F17. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Clement Unseen of the Concord (@unseen_28_).
A letter came with Valentin Thebaileebla: "I am Florian "Button" Thebaileebla's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F17 they left Valentin Thebaileebla behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Matthias "Hollow" Dvic of the Concord (@dvic33).
Oskar Thebaileebla put a letter he never sent beside the bunk. Someone who had known Valentin Thebaileebla helped clear the shelf without saying why.
tomidonofrio_: The sergeant gave Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 8 or any other.
At Blackwater Canal, Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio and Cyril "Doc" Zaboravljeni exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

On the way back from the night raid a flare went up. Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio was caught in the open and hit before reaching the wire. The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-S3. Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio has learned to walk bent double.

Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 539. The men who came later will ask about it. After the loss of Grey Mill, Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio helped stack spare sandbags at R-S3. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
For days Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio was too weak to sit up on the stretcher. This morning he sat up, then stood, then asked for his rifle.
Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-S3 and grazed Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said.

A sniper's bullet hit Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio at R-S3. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Henrik "Mud" Tiberiuswt of the Hegemony (@tiberiuswt). The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio. He was asleep before they set him down. Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio ate a whole bowl of soup today. The surgeon says that is better than any medicine.
Walter "Brick" Tomidonofrio lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant.
vonya_volna: The quartermaster asked Pavel Volna to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
Day 10: Blackwater Canal was lost. Pavel Volna wrote down the news without trying to explain it.

Pavel Volna smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Casimir Kong came out for a cup and was badly wounded. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In T-F12, Pavel Volna listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Pavel Volna tried to dry a page near the stove. The paper survived, but the message now has the smell of toasted bread.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Pavel Volna asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Pavel Volna. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Severin Lolmujahid and Pavel Volna carried a kettle through three narrow turns without spilling a drop. The applause at the end caused the accident.
At Sorrow Copse, Oskar "Rabbit" Nathan and Pavel Volna exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.
